dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: No, I can't. But my grandmother can.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, aɪ ˈkænt. bʌt maɪ ˈɡrænmʌðər ˈkæn.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, I can. My mom can sew, too.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, aɪ ˈkæn. maɪ ˈmɑːm kən ˈsoʊ, ˈtuː.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: No, not at all! Can you?
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, ˈnɑːt ət ˈɔːl! kən ˈjuː?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Yes, I can. I can teach you!
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, aɪ ˈkæn. aɪ kən ˈtiːtʃ juː!
